title: Coda Desktop Welcome Screen with Project Options
description: Add a welcome screen to the Coda desktop app that shows two options on startup: (1) Create a new project — a form with project name and folder picker that scaffolds .coda/project.json; (2) Open an existing project — a folder picker. After selecting/creating a project, proceed to the main dashboard UI with the project path shown in the title bar.
summary: Added a welcome screen to the Coda desktop app showing two options on startup: Create New Project (form with name + folder picker that scaffolds .coda/project.json) and Open Existing Project (folder picker validating .coda/project.json). Added IPC handlers in main.ts, window.dialog/window.project bridges in preload.ts, and WelcomePage component plus projectPath state in renderer.tsx.
